newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris full-freighter flights up 20.5pct Jan-Jun 97.
newsitem.headline: Paris full-freighter flights up 20.5pct Jan-Jun 97.

text.p: Freighter flights at the Paris airports totalled 10,852 in Jan-Jun or up 20.5 percent from Jan-Jun '96, airport authority (ADP) figures show.
Freighters at Charles de Gaulle rose 22.2 percent to 9,951, whilst those at Orly rose 4.6 percent from Jan-Jun '96 to 901.
ADP said total Jan-Jun air cargo throughput was 552,149 tonnes with the full-freighter share at 42.0 percent of the overall figure, compared to 39.4 percent in Jan-Jun '96.
In tonnage terms, freighters moved 231,681 tonnes of Paris traffic in the first six months of 1997, a rise of 9.1 percent on 1996 levels.

All cargo flights accounted for 3.5 percent of all flights operating at the Paris airports in Jan-Jun compared to three percent in the same 1996 period. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
